$comment: Contract between the phone's offline queue (mobile/src/offline) and POST /api/evidence/upload. Checked by mobile/src/offline/__tests__/contract.test.ts and backend/tests/test_mobile_contract.py. Spec §43: the local copy is deleted only after the server's sha256 equals the phone's.

fields.sha256: Lower-case hex sha256 of the file bytes, computed on the phone before encryption.
fields.captured_at: ISO 8601 timestamp with offset, phone clock.
fields.client_item_id: Random id of the queue item; equals the Idempotency-Key header.
fields.capture_id: Optional. Groups the pages of one multi-page scan.
fields.page_count: Optional. Number of pages in capture_id.
fields.original_url: Optional. The shared link, for format=url.
fields.hints: Optional. JSON object with advisory hints (qr, quality, title). Never evidence.

receipt.$comment: 2xx (or 409 for an already-stored file) JSON body. sha256 MUST be computed by the server over the bytes it stored, not echoed from the request.
